accueil.apercuTitre: A living ticket that a screenshot can't copy
accueil.apercuTexte: Each ticket has its own Kuba pattern that moves and changes every 30 seconds. The gate staff can tell at a glance if it's real.
accueil.videTexte: Come back soon, or see what's on in other cities.
accueil.attenteTexte: Concerts, matches, festivals, talks and shows: as soon as tickets go on sale, the event shows up on this page.
accueil.etapesTitre: Pay with Mobile Money in 3 steps
accueil.etape1Texte: Prices in CDF, with the USD equivalent. Up to {max} tickets per person.
accueil.etape2Texte: A message from your mobile operator pops up. You type your PIN in it. We never ask for it.
accueil.etape3Texte: It opens even without internet. Show it at the entrance and the staff will scan it.
accueil.orgaTexte: Sell your tickets online, track sales by operator and by category, and check people in even with no network at the stadium.

alertes.texte: Get an SMS when a new event is published.
alertes.consentement: I agree to receive SMS from e-Ticket RDC when an event is published. I can unsubscribe at any time on the SMS alerts page.
alertes.consentementRequis: Tick the box to agree to receive SMS.
alertes.succes: Done. You'll get an SMS as soon as an event is published.
alertes.desinscrireTexte: Enter your number and we'll stop the SMS alerts right away.
alertes.desinscrit: Done. You won't get any more SMS alerts.

telephone.label: Phone number
telephone.invalide: Enter a 9-digit number, without the leading 0.
telephone.opInconnu: Operator not recognized: you'll choose it in the next step.

evenement.regle1: 1 ticket = 1 entry. Keep your phone charged.
evenement.regle2: The ticket opens even without internet.
evenement.regle3: Refunds only if the event is cancelled.
evenement.listeAttenteTexte: Leave your number and we'll text you if seats become available.

evenement.listeAttenteConsentement: I agree to receive an SMS from e-Ticket RDC if seats become available for this event.

achat.attente3: Type your PIN in that message, then confirm.

achat.payeeSansPlace: We received your payment, but the seats were taken while you were paying. You'll be refunded: our team will contact you by SMS.

agent.etape2: Your operator sends you an SMS with a transaction reference.
agent.etape3: Enter that reference here. We check it and your tickets arrive by SMS.

agent.referenceAide: You'll find it in your operator's confirmation SMS.

agent.dejaUtilisee: This reference has already been used.

billet.pdfMention: 1 ticket = 1 entry. The living ticket on your phone is still the safest option at the gate.

mesBillets.horsLigneTexte: Tickets marked "On this phone" still open.
mesBillets.conseil: At the entrance, turn up the brightness and show the screen. The staff check that the pattern moves and that the sign matches theirs.
mesBillets.videTexte: Your tickets show up here as soon as you buy one.
mesBillets.connecter: Log in with your number to find your tickets.

connexion.texte: We'll send you a code by SMS. No password to remember.

scan.aucun: No event has been assigned to you.
scan.listeRequise: The scanner can't start without the ticket list. Connect to the internet once first.
scan.placer: Place the QR code inside the frame
scan.verifierSigne: Then check that the pattern moves and that the sign is a
scan.motifTexte: The phone must show the same one, moving.
scan.inconnuTexte: This code isn't in this device's list. Call a supervisor before letting the person in.
scan.refuseTexte: This QR code isn't a ticket for this event.
scan.camera: Allow the camera to scan, or type in the ticket number.

aide.secretTexte: Only type your PIN in your operator's message, on your phone. e-Ticket never asks for it: not by phone call, SMS or WhatsApp.
aide.rienRecu1: Check that your phone has network.
aide.rienRecu2: Open your operator's menu to see the pending request.
aide.rienRecu3: Check your balance: you need at least the amount shown.
aide.rienRecu4: If money was taken, your tickets will arrive by SMS within 15 minutes. Don't pay a second time.
aide.agentTexte: Choose "Pay at an agent" when paying. You get an order code and the merchant number. Send the exact amount, then enter the transaction reference you receive by SMS. Your seats are held for 2 hours and your tickets arrive by SMS as soon as an agent has checked the payment.
aide.billetsTexte: Once saved on your phone, your tickets open even without internet. Find them in "My tickets" by logging in with your number, or with the link you got by SMS. At the entrance, turn up the brightness and show the screen.
aide.remboursementTexte: Refunds only if the event is cancelled.
